newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telesp 9-mth net projected.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telesp 9-mth net projected.

text.p: -- HSBC James Capel said it expects Brazilian state telecoms firm Telesp will post a 578 million-real net profit for the first nine months versus 511 million reais by the end of August.
-- "We believe the results were impacted by non-operating financial adjustments," the brokerage said in a report.

-- It projected Telesp's sales in the January-September period at 3.631 billion reais as well as net income of 792.3 million reais, or 14.82 reais eps, in 1996 and 1.089 billion reais, or 18.94 reais eps, in 1997.
-- Telesp will post nine-month revenues of 2.62 billion reais versus 2.3 billion reais in the January-August period, it said.
-- The firm is due to make public its nine-month financial statements around Nov 15, the brokerage said.
-- Telesp, a unit of federal telecoms monolpoly Telebras, serves Sao Paulo state.
-- James Capel said Telesp's line growth should accelerate in the coming months, with the firm reporting installed cellular lines totalling 580,000 by the end of September, up from 546,000 on Aug 30.
-- "We are looking for a pick-up as Telesp's year-to-date line growth has been below expectations," it said, adding the shortfall was blamed on funding and equipment delays.
